AGO.note: Data protection is named only as one pillar of the draft Digital Government Law, not a data protection law.
No online government service is stated.

facts.fact: Angola's Instituto de Modernizacao Administrativa (IMA) says the draft Digital Government Law is available for consultation online on the public consultations portal.

IMA says the draft Digital Government Law, of 13 chapters and 107 articles, was put to public consultation on 6 May; it is meant to set the framework for digital public services and interoperability between state institutions.
facts.system: Anteprojecto de Lei do Governo Digital

facts.fact: IMA held a public consultation session on 6 May at ENAPP on the draft Digital Government Law, with public institutions, experts, jurists, academics and digital ecosystem partners.
